name: investor-marks
purpose: The investors band: a centered section title over a two-column bento grid where each cell is an investor's mark, linked to its site, that lifts on hover to reveal a "visit website" line. It is a page section — the site places it from a `{ _id: 'investor-marks', props }` entry and binds `props` straight onto it — and it composes `section-module`, `section-title`, `frame-box` and `bento-grid`.
useWhen: On the company page, to name the investors with their marks.
related: bento-grid` — the grid the marks are laid in.
bestPractices: Give each item a `logoLight` when its mark needs a different file on the light theme; otherwise one `logo` serves both.
Keep `linkLabel` short; it is revealed under the mark on hover and read before the investor name.

props.name: title
props.doc: Headline of the band, rendered by the centered section title as its `h2`; the band renders no header when empty.

props.name: linkLabel
props.doc: Line revealed under a mark on hover, and the start of each link's accessible name.

props.name: items
props.doc: The investors, in order; each is `{ name, logo, logoLight?, href }` where `logo` is the mark on the dark theme and `logoLight` the one on the light theme.

examples.name: Default
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import monasheesExtendedMono from '@aziontech/webkit/assets/monashees-extended-mono.svg'
  import monasheesExtendedReversed from '@aziontech/webkit/assets/monashees-extended-reversed.svg'
  import qualcommExtendedMono from '@aziontech/webkit/assets/qualcomm-extended-mono.svg'
  import qualcommExtendedReversed from '@aziontech/webkit/assets/qualcomm-extended-reversed.svg'
  import InvestorMarks from '@aziontech/webkit/investor-marks'
</script>

<template>
  <InvestorMarks
    eyebrow="Investors"
    title="Backed by visionary investors"
    link-label="Visit website"
    :items="[
      {
        name: 'monashees+',
        logo: monasheesExtendedReversed,
        logoLight: monasheesExtendedMono,
        href: 'https://www.monashees.com'
      },
      {
        name: 'Qualcomm Ventures',
        logo: qualcommExtendedReversed,
        logoLight: qualcommExtendedMono,
        href: 'https://www.qualcommventures.com'
      }
    ]"
  />
</template>
